1.title: NIGHT ONE
lines: 23:14. Everyone else went home hours ago.
You handle accounts for Meridian. Requests land in RELAY, INBOX and LEDGER. You either APPROVE them or HOLD them.
Check SENTRY before you decide. It logs every login, device and city.
Approve an attack and the money is gone. Hold a real request and a real person files a complaint. Both cost you.

2.title: NIGHT TWO
lines: IT pushed two detection rules to your console tonight.
Open RULES any time to read what is active. A rule firing is a reason to look harder, not an automatic answer.

3.title: NIGHT THREE
lines: Finance flagged unusual movement this week.
Two more rules are live. Watch for amounts that sit just under a reporting line, and for senders firing off attempt after attempt.

4.title: NIGHT FOUR
lines: Someone has been reading up on Meridian. And on you.
Your personal account is reachable from this machine tonight. Some of what arrives will be aimed at you, not the company.
Two more rules are live. Pressure and irreversible payments.

5.title: NIGHT FIVE
lines: Word got around that someone tried to move a large wire past you.
Two final rules are live: off hours access, and people reaching for permissions their job does not carry.

6.title: NIGHT SIX
lines: Last night on the account. Every rule is active.
Nothing new is coming to help you. Read the log, ask the questions, make the call.
